findings.passage: Make Americans' Votes Count Again Ensure 100% election integrity through transparency, accountability, and secure voting procedures. Support same-day, in-person voting using verifiable, watermarked paper ballots. Limit mail-in ballots to rare, verified exceptions to protect against fraud and maintain confidence in election results.

Does not mention photo ID, proof of citizenship or the SAVE Act.
